# P03 Regulatory Gap Analysis: Cris Santos Company | Finance and Insurance | Micro: Community credit union

| Scenario brief | [README.md](../README.md) |

**Regulation to analyze:** Interagency Guidelines Establishing Information Security Standards, 12 CFR 30 App. B; 12 CFR 208 App. D-2; 12 CFR 364 App. B
**Why:** Cris Santos Company is a community commercial bank in this vertical, so the GLBA Interagency Guidelines (examined through the FFIEC IT Examination Handbook) bind it directly regardless of size. Research note: For critical financial services (depository institutions and their service providers), examiners assess against the Interagency Guidelines using the FFIEC IT Examination Handbook; with the FFIEC CAT sunset (Aug 31, 2025), the Guidelines plus NIST CSF 2.0/CRI Profile are the natural gap-analysis target. Use Reg SCI for market infrastructure and NYDFS Part 500 for NY-licensed entities. If the bank is New York-chartered, NYDFS 23 NYCRR 500 also applies.

**Applicability check first:** at this size the business is a community credit union. Decide whether Interagency Guidelines Establishing Information Security Standards applies directly or only through contracts. If it does not apply, analyze the regulation that governs this business, and record the reasoning.
